messages:
alice: FYI: launching an opt-in preview SDK channel plus a small docs policy change today. Short summary below. :megaphone:

tom: preview channel = nightly artifacts pushed to rw-sdk@preview?

alice: yes, nightly + weekly snapshot. No forced upgrades; opt-in only via CLI flag or account setting.

rachel-docs: docs policy change?

alice: any PR that touches API surface or SDK examples must include a one-line CHANGES entry. CI will warn if missing.

infra-bot: deploy: preview artifacts published -> rw-sdk@preview-20260312 (sha:bead1234)

legal-sam: note: telemetry must be explicit opt-in for non-enterprise; enterprise defaults to opt-out and needs checkbox in UI.

rachel-docs: will add migration note for small playground field `runtimeHints` (backwards compatible). PR by EOD.

alice: rollout plan: day 0 publish, day 2 console banner, day 7 stricter CI enforcement. Use `rw-sdk install --channel preview` to test and report regressions in #eng-runtime.
